# NotificationsConfig

> **File:** `config/NotificationsConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the Notifications section (toasts and the history). Named NotificationsConfig because `Notifications` is a surface, module and bar widget type.

### Properties

- `screen` (readonly var): The ScreenTarget toasts show on (see General.screensFor)
- `position` (readonly string): "topLeft" | "topRight" | "bottomLeft" | "bottomRight"
- `top` (readonly bool)
- `left` (readonly bool)
- `evenGaps` (readonly bool)
- `gapTop` (readonly int)
- `gapBottom` (readonly int)
- `gapLeft` (readonly int)
- `gapRight` (readonly int)
- `timeout` (readonly int): Toasts
- `appTimeouts` (readonly bool): Use a notification's own expireTimeout (0 = never) when it sets one
- `criticalStays` (readonly bool)
- `maxToasts` (readonly int)
- `width` (readonly int)
- `quietFullscreen` (readonly bool)
- `clearOnFocus` (readonly bool): History
- `removeOnClick` (readonly bool)
- `closeRemoves` (readonly bool)
- `maxEntries` (readonly int)
- `maxAge` (readonly real): How old an entry may get (ms), 0 = keep forever
